scientific_scope_findings: All fourteen parameter rows across all three technologies, including each alternative literature value and its own citation, are directly checked. Ranges count as value cells, not endpoint counts; bibliographic years do not inflate numeric value counts.
The two AEMEL CAPEX/OPEX slash entries are original unspecified/absent parameter entries, not numerical zeros and not the conditional /b topology markers in Table 5.

The AEMEL 74.7% explicitly denotes cell efficiency, while row context is System/LHV. Do not silently interpret it as directly comparable system LHV efficiency or infer a performance ranking from the largest number.

Stack lives explicitly mix years and hours; AEMEL system lifetime 20 has no unit printed in that cell or its blank row-unit column. Preserve that lack rather than silently label it years or convert operating hours to calendar years.
Cold start footnote b defines below50°C; cold/warm order and each h/min/s unit and inequality remain material. Original >10s warm PEMEL value is not silently changed to <10s.

Scale footnote a and power-dependent PEMEL efficiency footnote c condition the cost/efficiency claims. Keep the technology/citation-specific alternative ranges, not one arbitrarily selected representative.

Structured auxiliary cells preserve correct AEL <30Bar and AEMEL <35Bar. The same auxiliary flat exact_visible_text incorrectly states AEL <35Bar. Preserve this intra-output inconsistency; numeric flat-string heuristics cannot approve the structured and flat records together.

Raw parser shifts CAPEX825 into OPEX, OPEX5 into efficiency, stack55000–96000h into system life, PEMEL20y into partload, AEL1–200Bar into temperature, and fragments current-density/development rows. All original raw mistakes remain saved.

Literal punctuation such as 1.500–2.200USD/kW and 60.000–100.000h is retained. Original alternatives provide context, but this record does not silently normalize thousands separators or approve extrapolation.

scientific_scope_findings: All five parameters across all three stationary technologies, every alternative literature/company value and citation, explicitly checked against the full page and high-resolution crop.

The OPEX row header says percent of investment but cells also supply13.4USD/kW/year and100$/kW/year. Preserve both the literal header and each local unit. Do not transform13.4USD/kW/year into13.4% or compare absolute rates to an unlabeled percentage.

PEMFC stack row unit h coexists with an explicit10y literature entry; explicit cell-specific unit takes its own meaning. PAFC system lifetime is literally2y although its reported stack life is70000–80000h; preserve primary values without a fabricated20y correction or assuming full-time utilization.

Stack-life ranges, individual company estimates and OR relationships remain separate observations. The PEMFC34000h Ballard and PAFC70000h Doosan estimates do not replace the corresponding literature ranges.

Complete page6/7 prose selects PEMFC2700USD/kWel and electrical system efficiency50% for the model. Those are paper modeling assumptions, distinct from the table alternatives and not a laboratory validation claim.

Raw parser omits OPEX/electrical-efficiency/stack-life labels, detaches alternativeCAPEX values and system-life20/20/2 from their proper row, combines efficiency/stack figures, and corrupts company34000/70000 into letter-O tokens. Structured auxiliary rows preserve these full values and scopes.
